corpus_row.expected_class: not a TE - host ribonuclease HI (rnhA), a single-copy chromosomal RNase H gene
corpus_row.why_safe: Confusion axis: bacterial RNase HI is the reference fold for the RNase H domain carried in the pol polyprotein of every LTR retrotransposon/retrovirus and in many non-LTR elements, so an RNase-H-domain profile hit here is essentially guaranteed. Tool-independence: the label rests on in vivo complementation of an rnh-deficient E. coli strain and on Mg2+-dependent RNA:DNA-hybrid cleavage assayed with purified recombinant protein - enzymology, not annotation. The deposit is a 1062 bp discrete gene record for a single-copy housekeeping gene, with no RT, no integrase, no terminal repeats and no target-site duplications. Adds a thermophilic-bacterium taxon absent from the existing negative panel.
